notes: «سألت معلى الرازي ... فأخبرني عن عيسى بن يونس»: the asker Fadl is first, the one asked Mu'alla second (rule 5)
«قال كنت على بابه» is Isa's own account; Sufyan answers Isa's question inside it, so he is the last link (rule 6)
«روى عنه، عباد» is part of the question about محمد بن سعيد and names no transmitter in the chain
